definitions.explanation: The account for payment at a restaurant, bar, or shop.
The act of calculating numbers or counting.
Taking something into consideration or account.

examples.japanese: お{勘定|かんじょう}をお{願|ねが}いします。
{勘定|かんじょう}が{合|あ}わない。
{経費|けいひ}を{勘定|かんじょう}に{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To include expenses in the calculation.

notes:
{勘定|かんじょう} has several related meanings around calculation and payment.

SENSE 1 - BILL:
- お{勘定|かんじょう} (the bill - polite)
- {勘定|かんじょう}を{払|はら}う (to pay the bill)
- Traditional term; {会計|かいけい} is more common now

SENSE 2 - CALCULATION:
- {勘定|かんじょう}する (to calculate)
- {勘定|かんじょう}が{合|あ}う (numbers match)
- {勘定|かんじょう}が{合|あ}わない (numbers don't match)

SENSE 3 - CONSIDERATION:
- 〜を{勘定|かんじょう}に{入|い}れる (to take ~ into account)
- {勘定|かんじょう}{外|がい} (not taken into account)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {会計|かいけい}: check (modern term)
- {計算|けいさん}: calculation (general)
